name: Dakhla – Speed Spot (PK25 camps)
notes: Flat shallow lagoon in front of the PK25 camps (Dakhla Attitude), NNE wind side-off; rideable at all tides, standing depth at low tide. The Speed Spot proper (round the corner, behind a sandbar) works only at low tide in offshore wind: advanced riders, no rescue boat.

name: Dakhla – Dune Blanche
notes: Flat water behind the white dune, reached by car from the N1 or by downwinder; the dune is only surrounded by water around high tide. Offshore wind, advanced riders.

name: Dakhla – Oum Labouir (Westpoint)
notes: Atlantic-side wave spot west of town, also called Foum El Bouir: point break, best waves November to February. Wind lighter and gustier than on the lagoon, rocky bottom in places at low tide.

name: Essaouira
notes: Long bay south of the town, small waves sheltered by Mogador island; strong N-NE trade wind cross-onshore, all levels. Avoid the town end (gusty, rocks).

name: Moulay Bouzerktoun
notes: Wave spot north of Essaouira, big waves on a good swell; strong wind and current, experienced riders.

name: Sidi Kaouki
notes: Long beach south of Essaouira with strong wind and waves; wave riding, mostly for experienced riders.
